outcome: An API error tells the caller which dependency failed without telling them anything else.

expected_verification.assertion: an ordinary Error maps to internal_error with no detail

acceptance_criteria.text: The detail returned for an upstream failure contains nothing that is not safe for the caller to see.

expected_verification.assertion: an upstream error carrying a connection string and an authorization header maps to a detail containing neither

data_impact: None. Error mapping is per request.
security_impact: Credential disclosure to any caller who can provoke an upstream failure.
rollback: git revert restores the opaque message.
